title: CG7 M.2 Q-DC: domain-classifier exploratory permutation test under the null (plan G.7, M.2)
stopping_rule: One locked run with the seed below.
An implementation bug reruns the panel only; the rerun and its reason are recorded next to the original outcome.
A correctly implemented failure is retained and the exploratory test is disabled (the classifier stays descriptive).
No threshold, seed or design change after the run.

panel.check: Null rejection rate of the exploratory permutation test at 0.05: reference and current entities drawn from the same distribution (two categorical and two numeric features, one with missing values); keyed 50/50 entity split; HistGradientBoosting fit on half A; 10,000 label permutations among half-B entities
panel.acceptance: fail only if the one-sided exact binomial test of the rejection count against 0.05 rejects at 0.001
